best_idea: Decide each chat line's audience from the round phase, the speaker's side and role, and the listener's side, and let the server deliver a sanitized line (same shape, no words) to anyone who should not see the original.
decision_why: Take the audience gate and the role-only channel for a live Pit bout (spectator text hidden from fighters and coaches while the bout is live; a coach's side-chat visible only to that side); keep the random-word mumble off by default and make it a spectator option only.
acceptance: During a live bout a spectator's line reaches other spectators and not the fighters; a fighter's team-only line reaches only that fighter's side; after the bout ends the same spectator line reaches everyone. A server test asserts the listener set.
